name: yila
description: Draw and revise scientific figures on the Yila canvas, and search, check and format scholarly literature with Yila, inside your agent.

interface.shortDescription: Your research workbench and figure canvas, inside your agent.
interface.longDescription: Yila draws publication-quality scientific figures from the outline your agent writes and opens the editable Yila canvas in the host's built-in browser; it searches OpenAlex, PubMed, Google Scholar and Wanfang, resolves and checks references and formats them in 2,800+ styles including GB/T 7714, and saves papers and notes to your Yila account. Uses your Yila account and credits; no API key.
defaultPrompt: Connect to Yila, call yila_get_orientation, and introduce what Yila can do in my language.
